newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HAMBURG SIGN POLISH STRIKER DEMBINSKI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAMBURG SIGN POLISH STRIKER DEMBINSKI.

text.p: Hamburg on Thursday signed Polish international striker Jacek Dembinski from Widzew Lodz for one million marks ($600,000).

But the 27-year-old Dembinski, who has just finished the Polish first division season as the joint second highest scorer with 17 goals, is not expected to join the German club until after the start of the new Bundesliga season.
Widzew Lodz want him for the qualification stage of the European Champions' League before he can switch clubs.
